full_table_blockers.PPO: One genuinely original-bid-task PPO artifact with the exact frozen low must be trained or recovered, then five paired evaluation episodes; no matching local checkpoint exists.
full_table_blockers.LLM: Access a pinned Qwen3-32B-compatible server and explicitly locked prompt/ICRL protocol, then five paired episodes. No new LLM model training is intrinsically required.

case_and_analysis_lock: Freeze all nine row definitions and exact artifact/config/data hashes before opening new results; never silently replace unavailable rows.

If a held-out/generalization claim is required, add a separately labeled prospectively registered default-scenario panel on demonstrably unconsumed covered dates/noise, excluding all training, validation, earlier tests, later opened panels and preserved reservations.
Do not call days196/256 fresh: they were used repeatedly for checkpoint and cross-candidate selection. Do not call days207/248/249 or November2 confirmation panels newly untouched.
Pin the original rule macro, original two-bid-action macro semantics and exact low1007 everywhere required. Economic full-residual/zero-ask policies are a different task.
Hold initialization, market/weather/workload/RegD conditions, seed mapping, horizons, model determinism and failure accounting common across rows. Retain all attempts; no survivor-only aggregation.
Preserve selection receipts, all failed seed slots and the distinction between rollout SD and across-training-seed uncertainty.
